# Temporary allowlist of the unit-test gate (.github/scripts/unitgate), issue #204.
#
# Each line is a file that still breaks rule 1, 2 or 3 (testify, generated mocks, no specs.Describe) because
# the pull request named after the "|" is migrating it. A trailing "/" covers a whole directory.
# The gate FAILS when a listed file no longer violates (migrated or deleted), so the PR that migrates a file
# must delete its line, and this file can only shrink. Delete it once it is empty.
#
# Format: path | owner (PR number, or what is pending when no PR is open yet)
mocks/ | generated mockery output (imports testify/mock); delete mocks/ with its last consumers: #245, #246, #264 and the snapshots follow-up
